rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of a numerical compound
locative plural indicating the quantity within which
compound of yoni (womb) and yantra (mechanism), locative plural
past passive participle describing those subjected to suffering

items.question: Within how many womb-mechanisms are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The number specified is eighty-four thousand.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across the vast expanse of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
